report: Final answer audit of MPPSC 2018 Prelims Paper-I
method: Every question re-read and answered independently; the printed key compared with the stored answer; explanations rebuilt with a four-part standard (concept and justification, per-option reasoning tied to the option text, revision facts, takeaway). Corrections are recorded only where the evidence contradicts the key and another option is demonstrably right; items with more than one defensible answer, a defective stem or no option supported by the evidence are recorded as ambiguous instead of being forced to a letter.
